mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tt_action_attempt (action_job_id, attempt_no, execution_token, started_at, finished_at, effect_started_at, outcome, error_class, error_code, provider_reference, safe_summary) VALUES (#{actionJobId}, #{attemptNo}, #{executionToken}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{effectStartedAt}, #{outcome}, #{errorClass}, #{errorCode}, #{providerReference}, #{safeSummary})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tt_action_attempt WHERE action_job_id = #{actionJobId} ORDER BY attempt_no ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE tt_action_attempt SET outcome = #{outcome}, error_class = #{errorClass}, error_code = #{errorCode}, safe_summary = #{safeSummary}, finished_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE action_job_id = #{actionJobId} AND execution_token = #{executionToken} AND finished_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(attempt_no) FROM tt_action_attempt WHERE action_job_id = #{actionJobId}
